text:
Ava: Quick thread: final benchmark narrative for launch landing + webinar. Want extremely practical tiles: 1 bold claim, 1 supporting datapoint, 1 CTA.
Noah: Agree. Propose tiles: scatter (latency vs $/k tokens), tail histogram, quick bill calc. Keep copy one short sentence + one stat.
Sam: I'll run a compact bench: 45m, 60 concurrent chat sessions, randomized prompt lengths. Will output CSV + assumptions.txt.
Priya: Two CTA variants to A/B: 'Estimate your monthly spend' vs 'Claim free credits'. Wire to different UTMs.
Taylor: I'll design 3 mobile-first tiles and a small embedded calculator GIF. Need CSV by EOD to generate accurate charts.
Noah: Public copy should say 'Up to 40% lower per-token cost vs typical self-hosted setups' and link to appendix with exact baseline numbers.
Ava: Webinar plan: prerecord 8m demo, live 12m walkthrough, 25m Q&A. Host: Ava. Tag engaged registrants who ask product questions as MQL.
Sam: Run command for reproducibility:
```bash
./bench/bench_chat --concurrency 60 --duration 2700 --model redwood-pro --quant q4_0 --batch continuous --out bench_6840.csv
```
Sam: Deliverables: bench_6840.csv, assumptions.txt, small README. ETA: today EOD PST.
Priya: HubSpot mapping: fields= email, company, company_size, token_estimate, attended, asked_question. Routing: attended & asked_question -> SDR; score>75 or company_size>200 -> AE.
Taylor: Color comps: fast=teal, balanced=indigo, cost=amber. Will keep accessibility contrast.
Ava: OK. Final checklist: Sam upload artifacts to ticket, Taylor drop visuals, Priya wire landing + routing, Noah draft appendix baseline wording. Deck review tomorrow 09:30 PT.
Noah: I can also draft the one-slide interactive cost calculator to embed.
Ava: Locking plan unless objections. Thanks everyone.
DeployBot: Landing draft created: /benchmarks/latency-to-dollars-digest (staging).
